summary: Backend testing of Composite Products with new schema (listingId, price, dynamic stock). Found CRITICAL bug in POST /composite-products - MongoDB unique index conflict prevents creating new composites. GET, PUT, DELETE, SELL endpoints all working correctly.

critical.issue: DuplicateKeyError - MongoDB unique index `idx_listings_product_seller_unique` on {productId, sellerId} prevents creating multiple composite sellerListings with productId=null for same seller
critical.error: E11000 duplicate key error collection: midconnect.sellerListings
critical.root_cause: When creating composite sellerListing, productId is null. Unique index doesn't allow multiple documents with same (null, sellerId) pair
suggested_fixes: Option 1: Set productId = compositeProductId in composite sellerListing
Option 2: Make unique index sparse (allows multiple nulls)
Option 3: Use partial unique index excluding productType='composite'

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix POST /composite-products - resolve MongoDB unique index conflict for composite sellerListings
Recommend: Set productId = compositeProductId when creating composite sellerListing to ensure uniqueness
critical_code_review_comments: GET /available-products correctly returns listings grouped by category with listingId
GET /composite-products correctly calculates availableStock = min(component_stock / component_qty)
PUT /composite-products/{id} correctly updates name, description, price, and items
DELETE /composite-products/{id} correctly deletes composite product AND composite sellerListing
POST /composite-products/{id}/sell correctly deducts component stock and validates availability
Stock recalculation after sell is accurate
Composite listings are correctly excluded from available-products (productType != 'composite')
Firebase Auth is MOCKED - using dev-test-token

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: sellerListings collection has unique index on {productId, sellerId}. Composite sellerListings have productId=null, but index doesn't allow multiple documents with same (null, sellerId)
reproduction_steps: 1. Ensure one composite product already exists for the seller
2. POST new composite product with valid items
3. Server attempts to insert sellerListing with productId=null
4. MongoDB rejects due to duplicate key violation
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Set productId = compositeProductId in composite sellerListing, or modify index to be sparse/partial
